description: maven: a pom.xml <groupId> referencing an undefined ${property} is kept — never dropped — with the raw unresolved text as its identity, downgraded to Low confidence (invisible to the byte-diff; the resulting warning is this case's exit 1). Also exercises the pom's own self-identity emission: this pom's own fully-resolved coordinates are additionally emitted as a High-confidence self-identity component, adding no warning of its own
